name: Bicep Curl
common_faults: swinging the torso to initiate the rep
partial ROM not reaching full elbow extension at the bottom
elbows moving forward at the top reducing bicep tension

substitutions.note: eliminates cheating; harder at the bottom of the range

contraindications: elbow tendinopathy aggravated by loaded elbow flexion
resistance_profile: hardest at 90° elbow flexion where dumbbell lever is longest; easier at full flexion and full extension

provenance.notes: Standard elbow flexion isolation. Supinated grip maximizes bicep brachii contribution. SFR high for a direct bicep exercise — local stimulus with minimal systemic cost.
